goal: Is ke baad aap ?: operator se ek hi line mein do values mein se ek choose kar sakenge, usey cout ke andar mehfooz tareeqe se rakh sakenge, aur faisla kar sakenge ke kab aam if-else behtar hai.
warmup: Canteen mein cashier sochti hai: 'Agar student ke paas card hai, to price 100 hai, warna price 120.' Ek sawal, do possible jawab, aur aap bas ek chun lete hain. Programs yeh sab waqt karte hain: agar marks 50 ya zyada hain to result Pass hai, warna Fail. Ternary operator is chunav ko ek chhoti si line mein likhne deta hai.
definition: Ternary operator ?: ek chhota if-else hai jo ek value paida karta hai. Isey ternary is liye kehte hain kyunke is ke teen hisse hain: ek condition, true ke liye ek value, aur false ke liye ek value. Yeh aise likha jata hai: condition ? valueIfTrue : valueIfFalse. Agar condition true ho to aap ko pehli value milti hai, warna doosri.
howItWorks: Computer pehle condition check karta hai. Agar woh true ho, to sirf ? ke baad wali value use hoti hai. Agar false ho, to sirf : ke baad wali value use hoti hai. Doosri ko ignore kar diya jata hai. Kyunke poori cheez ek value hai, aap usey variable mein store kar sakte hain ya print kar sakte hain. Jab aap usey cout ke andar print karein, to poore ternary ko hamesha brackets mein rakhein, kyunke << ki priority ?: se zyada hai aur warna woh uska sirf ek tukra pakad le ga.
